description: Rx rollbox redistribution sim (SB3/TQC): an agent redistributes Rx stock between hubs over a 100-day episode under partial observability (RFID reports ~10% of stock) and a noisy demand forecast. Hard part is a delayed, sparse failure signal - running out of Rx - so the critic must value multi-day buffers. See problem.md/journal.md for the full history; M1 (truncation-at-horizon bootstrap) took Normal-ops success from 0% to ~45%.
goal: Never run out of Rx in Normal operations (success_fraction -> 1.0), then lift the other scenarios (Surge/lull, SP, Obstacle). If 1.0 is unreachable, get as close as possible and say so.
notes: Convergence is late (best near gen 500) and seed variance is 15-30 points, so screens mislead: confirm winners on multiple seeds before believing them.
realism_constraints: episode length stays at n_days=100 - shortening it changes what 'solved' means
RFID observability stays at 0.1 and forecast uncertainty at 0.02 (train==eval)
evaluation stays on the existing benchmark scenarios; no bespoke easier scenario
